services.wordpress: Apache + PHP 8.3, serves the store on host port 3000
services.setup: One-shot installer (WP core, WooCommerce, MOON theme, demo content). Runs, writes /var/www/html/.moon-setup-ok and then stays up so the health check can verify the install.

notes: The theme and the demo importer are bind-mounted from the repository; no build step is needed for PHP/CSS edits.
Admin login for the sandbox: admin / moon-dev-admin.
